label: Marketing A/B copy
description: Propose A/B (or multi-variant) marketing copy from a brief or draft for later human-gated publish connectors

description_i18n.en: Propose A/B (or multi-variant) marketing copy from a brief or draft for later human-gated publish connectors
description_i18n.zh_CN: 根据简报或草稿提出 A/B（或多变体）营销文案，供后续人工门控发布
description_i18n.zh_HK: 根據簡報或草稿提出 A/B（或多變體）營銷文案，供後續人工門控發佈

propose_guide: Use after marketing/campaign-brief or brand-voice when NL asks for A/B tests, variants, or alternate headlines/CTAs. Emit Internal variants (A/B, optionally C) with hypothesis and primary metric — do not send or post. Next steps: human picks a variant, optional marketing/brand-voice check, then connectors (linkedin/publish, mailchimp/campaign, twitter/publish, wordpress/post). Respect channel length limits (e.g. short for social, longer for email/blog).

propose_guide_i18n.en: After campaign-brief or brand-voice when NL asks for A/B variants. Emit Internal variants — do not publish.
propose_guide_i18n.zh_CN: 在活动简报或品牌语气之后，用户要 A/B 变体时使用。产出内部变体——不外发。
propose_guide_i18n.zh_HK: 在活動簡報或品牌語氣之後，用戶要 A/B 變體時使用。產出內部變體——不外發。

params.name: draft
params.description: Single draft to vary when brief is absent
params.example_nl: Write A/B LinkedIn posts for the launch brief
